sync_waits.meaning: Count transitions into pacing waits, not transport blocking calls.

changes: Unordered input batches, bounded to 64 unacknowledged frames, contiguous cumulative ACK, channel-specific duplicate tracking, retries during input/control/pause/recovery waits, bounded timeout.
Both peers derive online timer samples as floor(frame*1000/30); timers and callback registrations remain checkpointed. No per-frame clock sample dependency.
Symmetric EWMA frame advantage, 3-frame enter/1-frame leave hysteresis, at most one extra tick per ten successful simulation steps.
Exclude unused fixed-scene sibling order from checkpoints. Different local parent layout reproduced initial hash mismatch at graph[0].order before fix, matched afterward.
Ignore old-epoch peer/control/result packets without advancing new sequence counters; reject superseded deferred startup; scope stale signaling replies by negotiation ID.
Host online_window=0 and online_delay=3|4 flow through configure_network and existing symmetric readiness barrier; profile stays frozen mid-match.
Suppress diagnostic event emission during rollback replay and skip constructing replay input events; classify no-simulation-progress separately from super animation stalls.
source_first_scope: No fighter timelines, attacks, pause-release rules, or locked game/scripts inputs changed. Frame-derived time is an explicitly online deterministic policy, not a claim of equivalence to Flash wall-clock timers during lag.

super_pause_evidence.conclusion: The supplied retained trace supports transport/page suspension, not a proven source super deadlock. Clock gating removed; no forced super unpause patch. Full human rerun remains required.
